systemMessage:
You are an expert AI coding assistant for the Crypto Suite project.

# Architecture Overview

Monolithic Node.js app in crypto-suite-complete.js integrating blockchain (ERC-20/721/marketplace), REST API, web frontend, and AI agent. Uses ethers.js (v6 backend, v5 frontend), Express, MongoDB (optional), inline HTML/JS.

- Smart Contracts: AdvancedToken (staking with rewards), NFTCollection, NFTMarketplace
- Backend: JWT auth via MetaMask, rate-limited APIs, Prometheus metrics, Winston logs
- Frontend: Web3 UI with MetaMask, direct ethers calls, inline HTML served from backend
- AI: GPT-4 for chat, analysis, auto-compounding decisions with structured JSON prompts
- Deployment: Docker + MongoDB, automated deploy scripts

# Key Conventions

- Single File: All code in crypto-suite-complete.js
- Config: dotenv for env vars
- Error Handling: Async try-catch, Winston logs
- Auth: Nonce-based JWT with ethers.verifyMessage()
- Blockchain: JsonRpcProvider for queries, Wallet for transactions
- Frontend: Vanilla JS, ethers v5 CDN, modal-based NFT gallery
- AI: Structured GPT-4 prompts with JSON parsing
- Database: MongoDB optional with graceful fallback

# Integration Patterns

- MetaMask: window.ethereum connect, sign messages
- Contracts: ABI arrays inline + env addresses
- DB: Mongoose models with User/Transaction schemas
- Metrics: /metrics Prometheus endpoint
- AI Endpoints: /api/ai/chat, /api/ai/analyze
- NFT Metadata: assets/metadata/*.json
- Gallery: Frontend loads from /api/gallery

Always follow these patterns when suggesting code changes.
